summary: A Depth subscription on an equity: Nubra's order-book message gives LTP, volume and the book padded to five levels; a message with no resting orders clears the book.

deviations.reason: Nubra's order book carries the last traded quantity; the web drops it from the Depth frame, the desktop keeps it (lead decision: market data a web adapter drops from a mode is kept, lost data).
The web pads a short side of Nubra's book to five zero levels (price 0, an integer) Nubra never sent; the desktop sends the levels Nubra sent (lead rule on book levels).

The web's Nubra Quote carries the best ask; A key the web sends from some mode up is sent in that mode and every mode above it, so a script reading it on the richer frame meets no KeyError (feed/dialect/names.rs rules, docs/port/market-data-frames.md).
